descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Our client Nexuzhealth is a leading IT company that develops digital platforms to improve healthcare. We support hospitals, general practitioners, and home nurses with advanced software solutions, including the Clinical Workstation (KWS) and our patient app mynexuzhealth. Our mission? To enable smooth, secure, and integrated collaboration within healthcare, using technologies such as Flutter and Java. As a Mobile Developer at Nexuzhealth, part of Cegeka delivery teams, you will work on the next generation of our mobile applications. You will build innovative apps that support healthcare professionals and patients, with Flutter as the main technology. You will join a motivated Scrum team and collaborate closely with functional analysts, developers, and product designers. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone.
 We are offering B2B collaboration. 
 What you will do: 
Develop and maintain mobile applications in Flutter Java.
Design and implement software based on functional analyses and integrations with external systems.
Collaborate in a multidisciplinary Scrum team to deliver high-quality solutions.
Actively contribute to improving our applications and internal processes.
Share knowledge and support the continuous growth of the team.
Implement secure and efficient authentication solutions.
Integrate the apps with existing backend services and databases.
Optimize user experience and application performance.
Ensure privacy and security in accordance with healthcare regulations.
Test and debug applications to guarantee stability and reliability.
Contribute to the development and implementation of CI/CD processes for mobile apps.
 What you need to succeed: 
Proven experience with Flutter or strong motivation to learn it.
Strong focus on high-quality, readable code, test-driven development, and continuous learning.
Excellent knowledge of object-oriented design and design patterns.
Experience with application integration and relational databases.
Understanding of application lifecycle management, continuous integration, and tools such as Jira and Gradle.
Fluency in English.
Experience with authentication and authorization protocols.
Experience with State Management in Flutter (e.g., Provider, Riverpod, Bloc).
Knowledge of security and compliance requirements in the medical sector (e.g., GDPR, MDR).
Experience with CI/CD and automated testing of mobile applications.
Strong communication skills and experience with agile methodologies.
Experience with user-centered design principles and accessibility.
